text:
Palladium Price in 2005
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2005, the LBMA palladium price rose 36.5% between 2005-01-31 ($189) and 2005-12-29 ($258). The highest sampled price was $258 in November and the lowest was $182 in February. The mean of these observations was $204. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
